main.description: Append-only signed device revocation record published to the user's repo via createRecord. Excludes a retired or revoked chat device from peer key-package directory verification without requiring deleteRecord permissions on blue.catbird.chat.device.

targetDeviceId.description: UUIDv4 device identifier of the revoked chat device (matches the record key).

actorDeviceId.description: UUIDv4 device identifier of the device that signed this revocation (targetDeviceId for self-retirement or an active sibling device).

signerPublicKey.description: MLS credential signature public key of actorDeviceId, matching its enrolled blue.catbird.chat.device record.

signature.description: Detached Ed25519 signature over CATBIRD-CHAT-PDS-DEVICE-REVOCATION-V1\0 || dag_cbor({ actorDeviceId, createdAt, repoDid, targetDeviceId }).

algorithm.description: Optional signature algorithm identifier ('ed25519' or 'p256'); defaults to 'ed25519'.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this device revocation record was created.
